column1: # BRG territory map — one owner per file.
#   owner    a chat id (`git config fc.chat`), or `*` = any chat may write
# LONGEST PATTERN WINS, so a specific row always beats the directory it sits in.
# A path that matches NO row is unmapped: always allowed, but reported — that
# report is the point, it's how a new top-level thing gets noticed instead of
# Site chrome — nav, footer. Declared here, RENDERED by conti's PHP rather than
# filled from a fragment, so it sits with the plugin that reads it.
# Retired stub pointing at the Atlas board. Conti's so nobody revives it as a board.
# The nav component is Conti's, NOT Finn's, despite the brgw- prefix. It is the
# body of the [brg_nav] shortcode: every one of its commits is a nav version bump
# that also moves SHORTCODES.md + docs/ + the plugin. `.bnav*` is deliberately
# namespaced away from Finn's `.brgw-*` in brgw.css for exactly this reason.
# (These rows are longer than `website/assets/brgw*` below, so they win.)
# ── finn — the build: page fragments, sections, shared engine ───────────────
# GENERATED OUTPUT IS OWNED BY THE OWNER OF ITS INPUT. website/acf/ is generated from
# each section's slots.json by kit/build-acf.py — the generator is conti's, the INPUT is
# finn's, so the OUTPUT is finn's too. Anything else is unsatisfiable: pre-push requires
# the regenerated groups in the same push as the slots.json that moved them, so whoever
# can edit the input must be able to commit the output. (Caught by the gate itself on its
# first day — finn had to use FC_ALLOW_CROSS to satisfy a rule only finn could satisfy.)
# The same rule keeps SHORTCODES.md + docs/ with conti: their input, kit/registry.json,
# GENERATED OUTPUT FOLLOWS ITS GENERATOR, not its subject matter.
# website/acf/ is written only by kit/build-acf.py (conti) and hand-edited by nobody.
# It sat with finn because the SLOTS that feed it are finn's — but that made every
# routine regeneration a cross-territory commit, which under block mode would mean
# typing an override as a matter of habit. An override people type by habit is not a
# guard. The inputs stay finn's: website/sections/<id>/slots.json is where the real
# decisions live and where review belongs.
# ↑ includes each section's slots.json. A slot and its {{token}} MUST ship in the same
# commit, which is impossible if one half lives in conti's sections.json — so the
# declaration sits beside the fragment, in the same territory as the markup that uses it.
# ── shared — every chat writes here, nobody owns it ─────────────────────────
# ── unowned — inputs, not authored code. Whoever needs them, edits them. ────
# ── expo — content strategy + the two unbuilt pages. Specs, not code. ──────
# Retired earlier on 2026-08-12, reinstated and re-scoped the same day (Sean).
# They own a staging area and their own log, nothing in production. Finished work
# is PROMOTED by whoever owns the destination — see work/README.md.
# work/ is deliberately OUTSIDE website/: the publish dir deploys to the public
# CDN, so prep work staged in there would ship to the internet. That has already
# happened twice in this repo (website/page-*.png, and mocks/ before it was ignored).
